pre_command: osascript -e 'tell application "Pages" to quit without saving' && osascript -e 'tell application "Numbers" to quit without saving' && osascript -e 'tell application "Keynote" to quit without saving' && osascript -e 'tell application "Pages" to activate' && sleep 5 && osascript -e 'tell application "Pages" to make new document with properties {document template:template "Modern Letter"}'
instruction: Help me zoom in the current document to exactly 300%.
evaluator: osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to get value of attributes of menu button "Zoom" of toolbar 1 of window 1 of (first application process whose frontmost is true)' 2>/dev/null | grep -q "300%" && echo "True" || echo "False"
